observation: The public Primary Chat should become the main human operating surface for Prometeo. ChatGPT conversation turns are temporary bootstrap/worker shells; durable public-safe replies, progress, next actions and route-back instructions should be projected into the public GitHub page so the human can leave ChatGPT for routine observation and re-entry.

existing_capabilities.input_boundary: composer exists but correctly fails closed without authenticated private ingress

target_model.rule: Every material Prometeo reply gets a public-safe message projection with full human-facing answer plus structured UI blocks.

privacy_boundary: Do not mirror raw private human prompts by default.
Publish sanitized intent summaries and assistant/Guide outputs that are explicitly public-safe.
Never embed credentials/tokens/private bridge payloads in GitHub Pages.
Public page is projection/interaction surface, not authority.

examples: NO_ACTION · 2 workers corriendo · volvé cuando ambos cierren
OPEN_WORKER · boundary requiere decisión en RUN X

public_runtime_rule: Prefer static compiled JSON projection fetched by the browser. Do not make the page query raw GitHub APIs or Supabase per widget when a compiler can publish compact state.
end_state: Human can open one Prometeo URL, read the complete current answer, watch durable progress, see exactly whether any action is needed, launch/copy the next worker instruction, and know when/where to return. Private authenticated input through the page remains a separate Bridge milestone.
non_goal: Do not invent a second chat authority or claim web input works before the authenticated private bridge exists.
